settings.title: our guarantee
settings.body: 30-day home trial and a 5-year structural warranty. if it's not for you, we arrange the pickup — no drama.

settings.statement: we help you recover, sleep, and feel years younger — in your own backyard, on your own schedule.

settings.heading: love the ritual, or we take it back
settings.body: try the big three at home for 30 days. keep the simple daily ritual — heat, cold, light — and see how you feel. if it isn't the best part of your day, call us and we arrange the pickup. no restocking games, no fine print. every system is covered by a 5-year structural warranty.

settings.q: do i need a contractor or an electrician?
settings.a: no contractor. the sauna arrives in flat panels and assembles in an afternoon with two people. entry models run on standard home power — and we confirm your exact setup before anything ships.

settings.q: how long until it's in my backyard?
settings.a: typically 2–3 weeks, fully insured and tracked. you get the tracking link the moment it ships, and the delivery team calls before the truck arrives.
the 2-person sauna needs roughly a 4×4 ft footprint on any flat, solid surface — a patio, deck, or level yard. the plunge and light tuck alongside.

settings.q: is the cold plunge safe for someone my age?
settings.a: you set the temperature and the pace — many owners start with cool water and a single minute. as with any new wellness routine, check with your doctor first if you have a heart condition.

settings.q: can i start with just the sauna?
settings.a: of course. the sauna stands on its own, and most owners add the plunge within a few months — the big three simply locks in the savings today.

settings.q: what if it isn't for me?
settings.a: you have 30 days at home. if the ritual doesn't stick, call us and we'll arrange the pickup. no lectures, no hassle.
